projects.title: Sunkissed Flavor
projects.description:
A beloved Sicilian brand for over a century, Tomarchio is renowned for its artisanal beverages made from the finest local ingredients. 

To promote their heritage and products, they turned to us for eye-catching billboard designs and engaging animations, helping them connect with a wider audience while celebrating their tradition.

New Look

For Tomarchio's billboards and animations, we embraced a lively, joyful aesthetic that celebrates their rich Sicilian heritage. Drawing from the playful trend of googly eyes, we brought the fruits to life as they gaze at the new bottle, accompanied by the…
